# Load Packages


```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(brms)
library(cmdstanr)
```

## Run Model

Now we will run this Bayesian model

```{r}

model_normal <- brm(body_mass_g ~ flipper_length_mm,
  family = gaussian(),
  backend="cmdstanr", 
  data = penguins
)

```
